items: 1½ cups bread flour (may use regular flour)

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.body: Mix together: **1½ cups bread flour** (may use regular flour), **¼ cup whole wheat flour** and **1 Tbsp yeast**.

steps.title: Add the liquids
steps.body: Heat in saucepan to 120°F, then add to the flour mixture: **1 cup eggnog**, **¼ cup water**, **¼ cup sugar**, **¼ cup butter** and **1 tsp salt**.

steps.title: Add flour
steps.body: Add and mix thoroughly: **1¼ cups + flour**.

steps.title: Fill the dough
steps.body: Roll out to 15×12 rectangle and spread with a mixture of: **2 Tbsp butter**, **¼ cup sugar**, **¾ tsp nutmeg** and **¼ tsp cinnamon**.

steps.title: Slice the rolls
steps.body: Roll starting at the short side, and cut to 12 1-inch slices.

steps.title: Make the bottom layer
steps.body: Heat in saucepan until mixture bubbles: **1 cup brown sugar**, **¼ cup butter** and **¼ cup eggnog**.

steps.title: Assemble the pan
steps.body: Place the mixture in the bottom of a greased 13×9×2-inch pan, and top with: **⅓ cup chopped cranberries** and **¼ cup chopped walnuts**. Then add sliced rolls.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake at 350°F for about 30 minutes, until golden.

steps.title: Invert
steps.body: Remove from the oven, let stand for 5 minutes, then invert.
